svg.title: Vuulgaris V1 faceplate, 298.286 x 137.81mm, true scale
svg.desc: Salamis Tablet faceplate at true millimetre scale. Four capacitive scrub pads 216mm long and 10mm wide at 18mm pitch (8mm gap), each drawn as 100 comb teeth split into complementary top and bottom bars across four interpolation zones in the order RX0 RX1 RX2 RX3 RX0. Above a straight divider rule, eight channel knobs on rules 2 and 4, a vertical divider, six dual-gang analog knobs for the filter and delay, 2 round toggle bushing holes, LPG mode and source, and the OLED at the right. 13 tick divisions per pad with crosses at marks 4, 7, 10, Greek acrophonic numerals in the margins, and the rotary encoder in the right margin beside the pads.
